entities.summary: Michelle Thorne is an American-born, Berlin, Germany-based internet culture and climate justice activist who is known for leading community initiatives at Mozilla and before then with Creative Commons. Her work focuses on knowledge sharing and on the social and planetary implications of new technologies.
